scene nodokashotengai1
: Okay, so, now that that’s over and done with and you’ve made everybody uncomfortable, what now? You promised us food and I have yet to see so much as a snack.
: Empty the purse, Nodoka. I know you’re holding out on us.
: Apologies. That ran longer than I expected. Guess my newest book is a bit of a hit, isn’t it?
: Yeah, I wonder where you got the story from?
scene nodokashotengai2
: What can I say? I can find inspiration in anything. I shan’t be blamed for simply drawing upon my own experiences.
: If you’d take the time to read it yourself, I’m sure you’d come to like it. It’s not as if I know everything. There’s plenty in there I was forced to make up.
: Hi. Rin here. Still hungry. Please feed.
: It’s late, but I don’t think anything around here closes down until a few hours from now. Did you get, like...some sort of allowance from your publishing company or whatever? How does this work?
scene nodokashotengai3
: It works via the combination of digital deposit and the magic, rectangular card in my pocket that I use to pay for everything.
: Oh, okay. So it’s not free. You’re just paying for it.
: It’s free for you, which we all know is the only thing that matters.
: I’d normally offer to pay, but I’ll accept an expensive dinner as compensation for using my likeness in your novel.
scene nodokashotengai4
: What do you mean you’d offer to pay? Aren’t you cheap as hell? When have you ever offered to buy me anything?
: I’ll start offering you things once you start being nicer to me and stop tackling me in dark rooms.

: Totally ignoring that I just heard any of that and getting back to the food thing- where are we going? There was this street we passed on the way here that I think should have a bunch of food trucks.
: It didn’t have any on the way over, but I’ve got a feeling they’re there now. And you can trust me. I have special food truck senses.
: I was thinking we could celebrate my success by doing something a bit more upscale. Perhaps a nice sushi bar or some other comparable restaurant?
scene nodokashotengai5
: Uhh, actually, Otoha and I kind of have a 0%% success rate when it comes to restaurant dates, so if we could choose somewhere that’s like, not inside...that would be cool.
: The sample size is only one, but...yeah. What Rin said.
: I remember that day. I made out with Otoha’s teacher in the bathroom.
scene nodokashotengai6
: You made out with yourself in the bathroom? How is that even possible?
: Do tell. And don’t mind if you see me reach into my pocket to press a button while you’re speaking. I can promise you I’m not recording any of this. You have my word.
: Your word means nothing to me, Nodoka. And I should probably stop talking about this since I’m finally on decent terms with your roommate again.
: Decent might be a bit of an overstatement, but thank you.
scene nodokashotengai7

: Is there anything that...fits our criteria around here? Because I’m not trying to be pushy but, if you can’t think of anything, I’m just going to start walking towards Schroedinger’s food truck alley.
: Hmm...I believe there’s a shotengai not far from here with a varied assortment of foods. I remember passing by during my last signing.
scene nodokashotengai8

: Time for another weebnote! A “shotengai” is a shopping street in Japan that is closed to car traffic! They’re typically stocked with local goods sold by local vendors at cheaper-than-average prices!
: If there’s something you’re looking for, whether it be croquettes, sandals, okonomiyaki, or other household items, the local shotengai is always a safe bet!
: Plus, shopping at them is great for stimulating the local economy! And many of them partner up with other vendors in the area for exclusive deals! I highly recommend them!
scene nodokashotengai9
: Why did Molly just show up and lecture Sensei about shotengai?
: She does that sometimes. She’s probably just one of Nodoka’s fans and was already in the area.
: What a shame. I never even got to sign a copy of my book for her. I wonder if she was too embarrassed?
: Molly? Embarrassed? Sure. And I prefer men.
: Let’s do this shotengai thing before everything closes down. I’d like to get as far away from here as possible as soon as possible before more people think I’m in costume.
scene nodokashotengai10
: I’m surprised they recognized you at all. That shirt looks significantly thinner than the one my book describes.
: Not hard to recognize a huge dude with a huge dick!
scene nodokashotengai11
: Bro.

: Otoha, I have absolutely no idea why I said that. I’ve never even seen it before. Unless you count the one time at the gym, but that was through the pants for like five seconds and it doesn’t count.
: Also my mom grabbed it and Futaba told me and you need to kiss me or I’m just going to keep ranting about this.
: Yeah...how about we eat first and make out later? I’d prefer if you’re not thinking about dicks while we’re kissing.
scene nodokashotengai12
: I understand and apologize. I will try harder to keep all phallic commentary to myself. My lips are sealed. Until you unseal them, I mean. At that point, they will come unsealed.
: Will you do me the honors of carrying my display-purse, Sensei? My hand is beginning to cramp.
: I will not and that sucks for you.
: Not even if I let you be my boyfriend for the rest of the night? It seems only fair that we couple ourselves together if our companions are going to be doing the same.
: Does it come with all of the standard benefits being a boyfriend entails?
: You mean like taking my pants off and gently nibbling on my-
scene nodokashotengai13
: Okay, come on. That’s enough of them for now.
: What?! But we were just about to get to the good part!
scene nodokashotengai14
: Otohaaaaa!
: Please continue. You didn’t get to finish your sentence.
: I don’t know. I quite like the idea of leaving a cliffhanger there.
: In fact...I think I’ll let you sweat for a little while longer.
: How much longer exactly? Because I don’t have all night.
: Of course you do. I advised you in the very beginning that this could run until tomorrow. And I need you here to make sure my plan pans out.
: It’ll be significantly harder achieving the result I want all by myself, you know.
: And that result is still...getting Otoha and Rin to fuck?
scene nodokashotengai15
: If it doesn’t happen tonight, I’m not sure it ever will.
: So I suppose you can walk away now if your end goal is sleeping with each of them quicker...
: But, if you’d like to take your time and focus on the others for now...and let the two of them explore one another's bodies on their way to makeshift happiness...
scene black
: Stay with me.
: Until the sun rises once more.
scene nodokashotengai16
She didn’t need to try and convince me.
As much as I’d enjoy having sex with all three of the girls I’m with tonight, I know it would be wrong to insert myself both in between and inside of the two furthest away from me.
All things considered, it would be wrong to insert myself inside of Nodoka as well — but that is a different sort of unacceptable that I’ve made overwhelmingly apparent to be unimportant to me.
What I’m trying to say is I want Rin to be happy. And to a real, yet relatively lesser extent, Otoha as well.
And if that means sidelining myself and going along with the plan of someone who may very well be a sociopath, so be it.
Because at least she’s being a sociopath in a nice way tonight and not locking the two of them in a room together and disallowing them to leave until they sixty-nine.
If that winds up happening, I’ll cut the cord with Nodoka for good.
Involve me in borderline sexual assault one time, shame on you. Involve me in that same thing twice...and we should probably both be in jail.
I still don’t know what her plan is- nor how I can help her with it.
But I know that, until the sun rises once more, I’ll be right here beside her.
: You guys ever just think about tacos? What an amazing invention these things are. They’re like little boats that you can eat.
: Very nice, Rin. Is that really all you’re having, Nodoka? Just...a single croquette? Rin and I have stopped at like seven stalls so far and I’m starting to feel bad.
: I’m not very hungry. But don’t let my poor appetite spoil dinner for either one of you. Stop wherever you like. The night is just getting started after all.
scene nodokashotengai17
: Started? Are we doing something after this? Because the answer to that question greatly influences the amount of tacos I am about to eat.
: I just figured it would be nice to wander through the streets with a group of people I’m close to. If only my dear Futaba was here to join us as well.
: You’re...the one who explicitly decided to not invite her. You can’t do that and then just wish she was here.
: I neglected to invite Futaba for her own well-being as discussing my latest work with her might prove to be a bit...difficult.
: Besides, I’m fun Nodoka right now. I don’t want to explain things. I explained things all day.
scene nodokashotengai18
: Right now, what I want more than anything is to enjoy my free time with you.
: Because who knows when the next time I’ll see either of you is after you discover how nice it feels to scissor later tonight?
scene nodokashotengai19
: Did I say something wrong? I meant that sincerely.
scene nodokashotengai20
: Nodoka, it’s because you meant it sincerely that it’s weird. Stop trying to rush us. Otoha wants to move slow.
: Seriously. Like, why do you have to be so involved in our personal...stuff anyway? It has nothing to do with you.

: My dearest Otoha, I’m writing a series based on our lives. Everything has to do with me now. If you delay any longer, I’ll just wind up having to make something else up. And where’s the fun in that?
: The fun is not getting in between us.
: I can’t say I agree. I think I’d have plenty fun in between you. But I understand that may be a little too much for all of us right off the bat.
: Otoha- permission to throw a taco at your roommate?
: Permission granted.
scene nodokashotengai21
: Wait, wait, wait. There’s no need to throw anything at me.
: All that will do is dirty this suit and force my boyfriend here to help me undress right in the middle of this shotengai. And I’m sure no one wants to see that.
: Taco attaaaaaaack!
: Rin, wait. No taco attack.
: No taco attaaaaack!
: Nodoka, I’m gonna be real with you. It’d be super cool if you stopped trying to start problems just so you could get some exciting material for your book or whatever. We’re not...playthings.
scene nodokashotengai22
: Otoha, thank you for “being real” with me. But you’re wrong.
: I’m not trying to start problems at all.
: Have I done that in the past? Maybe. Will I do it in the future? Another maybe. But right now, I’m just being eaten alive by curiosity.
: Your youth only comes once. Shouldn’t the two of you be making the most of it by engaging in constant lesbian sex with one another? That’s what I would be doing if I had a girlfriend.
: But alas, my desired female partner is but one more who has fallen victim to our teacher’s phallus.
scene nodokashotengai23

: Oh, and that’s another thing! Sensei, why are you not saying anything when Nodoka’s basically putting your whole ass creepy lifestyle on blast?! You saw yourself how many weird looks you were getting tonight!
: Otoha’s right. Couldn’t this book start like, major problems for you if the wrong person finds out about it?

: The two of you are overreacting. Fiction is fiction at the end of the day. And even novels that are based on real life events are often exaggerated beyond recognition. This is no different from that.
: I’ve even gone so far as to change the names of everyone involved.
: I don’t know. Rin to Ren doesn’t sound like that big of a change.
: Neither does Otoha to Otoka...
: If the two of you would just take the time to actually read the book before critiquing it to this extent, you’d have much more room to talk.
: But for now, I’d like to get back to the topic at hand and ask you when the two of you will be bringing each other to orgasm. Which, for the record, Sensei is also curious about.
: She’s not wrong. But also for the record, I have no part in this and haven’t really figured out how I feel about her book yet.
: Stop being curious about...stuff you shouldn’t be curious about! If you’re that horny, just fuck Nodoka or something! At the very least, it’ll get her off our backs!
: Or...don’t do that. Because you already have other people who...actually love you.
: Are you implying I don’t love my very own father-slash-boyfriend?
: Not in a way that sounds legal or socially acceptable...
: Otoha, like I said, I’m not involved in this- nor am I going to try and force you two into doing anything you don’t want to.
: Yeah, but you have no issue helping Nodoka do that, which is no different. Man up, dude.
scene nodokashotengai24
: You know I love you...don’t you, Papa? Or should I whisper it in your ear again tonight while we’re cuddled up in bed?
: Maybe...tone it down a little, Nodoka. I get that you have a difficult time noticing things like this, but Otoha’s actually starting to get kind of heated.
: Yeah, because I’m sick of people trying to tell me who I’m supposed to be or what I’m supposed to do or how I’m supposed to feel.
: Also, I’ve been holding onto this burger for so long without biting it that it’s probably bad now. So thanks, guys.
: Yeah...and my tacos have gotten so soggy that I’m not sure they’re even throwable anymore. Can we go back so I can get more?
: Psst...Papa.
: What do you want, fake-daughter?
: Ask them when they plan on fingering one another and I’ll do things to you in the closet later.
: Nodoka...
: Come on...The only way we’ll get them is through repetition.
: Sensei’s name is Akira and he’s been hiding it from everyone for reasons I don’t understand.
scene nodokashotengai25
: Hah...
: You have a name?!
: Akira?...
: You want to be on Nodoka’s side? Fine. I can throw dirt back at you. That was just the beginning.
: I was literally about to refuse Nodoka’s offer. But you were so trigger happy and determined to spill that information that you fired as soon as I opened my mouth.
scene nodokashotengai26
: Oh.
: Whoops.
: YOU HAVE A NAME?!
: I’m so used to you doing everything in the completely incorrect way that I kind of just figured that’s what you were going to do again. I’m sorry.
: In my defense, though, normal Sensei would never say no to having things done to him in the closet. So this is also kind of your fault for growing a spine out of literally nowhere.
: Also, your name is rad. What’s there to even be embarrassed about?
scene nodokashotengai27
: Akira...Arakawa...
: YOU-
: Rin, shh. Eat this burger.
: Mmffffghfhfissssocold!
: May I ask why you were keeping that name a secret?
: I technically wasn’t, but...it’s a long story.
: Is it...one you’d be willing to share?
scene nodokashotengai28
: Any reason why you’re so interested all of a sudden?
: No...not particularly.
: Just wondering...
: You’re significantly less wordy and pretentious all of a sudden.
: What do you mean? I’m the same person as always.
scene nodokashotengai29
: Ithnkyrjust.........
: Imgningthngs...
: Nodoka?
scene black
: Mmg......mglp...
: Cold...
